title: helianthemum hirtum var. teretifolium
intro: Helianthemum hirtum var. teretifolium, commonly known as Rockrose, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Cistaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues such as digestive problems, fever, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Rockrose include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-histamine effects.
